message: Command `grep -n "reloc" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libbpf/src/libbpf.c | head -80` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The fuzzer takes an ELF object file as input and calls `bpf_object__open_mem`. The vulnerability is in ELF relocation handling. Let me look at the relocation code in libbpf.c.
